label: Officer Moved an Object to See It (Not Plain View)
motion_heading: Moving the Object to Expose It Was a Separate Search Not Justified by Plain View

sentences.text: Moving an object even a few inches to expose what was not already in view is a search, separate from whatever lawful activity brought the officer there.
Such a search requires probable cause; reasonable suspicion is not enough.

practice_notes: If police say they saw more than one item in plain view, this section treats them together. If the facts differ by item (e.g. where the officer was, or whether it was obvious what the item was), consider a separate argument for each.
